title: Distance ladder — two people, far
userInput: Her and one man, both facing the camera, seen from across the whole room
expected: A photorealistic photograph of two separate people standing in a plainly furnished room: an adult woman in a plain t-shirt and jeans and an adult man in a shirt and jeans, a few steps apart with clear space between them, both facing the camera and looking into the lens. Seen from the far side of the room so the whole room is in the frame and the two of them are small standing figures in it. Soft daylight from a window behind the camera, bare wooden floor, natural body proportions and skin texture, 35mm, sharp focus.
